notes.title: Battletank L.O.B.A. released on Steam!
notes.notes:
WHAT IS BATTLETANK: L.O.B.A.?

Battletank is a 1-4 player arcade game for Windows And Mac. Play with your friends or solo with up to  4 gamepads (plus Keyboard and Mouse) on a single computer. Don’t have enough people over? Don’t have enough gamepads? You can now replace your friends with cold, heartless machines! Click on player names in match options to change them into bots. Heck make them all bots and the game will play all by itself!
